evidence: Modifies prioritisetransaction handling in src/rpc/mining.cpp and tests in test/functional/mining_prioritisetransaction.py to fix getblocktemplate transaction omission.
rationale: Bounding prioritisetransaction deltas prevents template construction from omitting prioritized transactions due to corrupted chunk fees. The PR shows extreme fee deltas caused getblocktemplate to omit affected transactions, though triggering the issue requires unrealistic deltas exceeding MAX_MONEY.
